title: Telemetry
description: Sensor readings from MQTT (sensors/<device-id>/<measurement>), stored in InfluxDB by Telegraf.

list.name: device
list.label: Device
list.query:
import "influxdata/influxdb/schema"
schema.tagValues(bucket: v.defaultBucket, tag: "device", predicate: (r) => r._measurement == "sensor_data", start: -30d)
list.definition:
import "influxdata/influxdb/schema"
schema.tagValues(bucket: v.defaultBucket, tag: "device", predicate: (r) => r._measurement == "sensor_data", start: -30d)

list.name: sensor
list.label: Sensor
list.query:
import "influxdata/influxdb/schema"
schema.tagValues(bucket: v.defaultBucket, tag: "sensor", predicate: (r) => r._measurement == "sensor_data", start: -30d)
list.definition:
import "influxdata/influxdb/schema"
schema.tagValues(bucket: v.defaultBucket, tag: "sensor", predicate: (r) => r._measurement == "sensor_data", start: -30d)

targets.query:
from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "sensor_data" and r._field == "value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.device =~ /^${device:regex}$/ and r.sensor =~ /^${sensor:regex}$/)
  |> group(columns: ["device", "sensor"])
  |> last()
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "device", "sensor"])

from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "sensor_data" and r._field == "value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.device =~ /^${device:regex}$/ and r.sensor =~ /^${sensor:regex}$/)
  |> group()
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1m, fn: count, createEmpty: true)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])

from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "sensor_data" and r._field == "value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.sensor == "${sensor}" and r.device =~ /^${device:regex}$/)
  |> group(columns: ["device"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "device"])

from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "sensor_data")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.device =~ /^${device:regex}$/ and r.sensor =~ /^${sensor:regex}$/)
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> group(columns: ["device", "sensor"])
  |> last(column: "_time")
  |> group()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({"Device": r.device, "Sensor": r.sensor, "Value": r.value, "Unit": if exists r.unit then r.unit else "", "Last seen": r._time}))
  |> sort(columns: ["Device", "Sensor"])
